body.value:
Для NGW/Collector или другого desktop/mobile контракта дополнительно прочитай
`docs/architecture/lisa-ecosystem.md` и `docs/registry/ecosystem.yaml`.
Android не зависит от файлов `standart_profiles` и QGIS plugin workspace
напрямую; общая runtime-граница проходит через NextGIS Web либо явный import
поддерживаемого переносимого артефакта.

review.value: Complete cross-platform prerequisites and server/portable import boundary without desktop-file runtime reads.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
